event: Floor 20's crystal spires give off a low, continuous ringing tone.
Solenne feels the tone in the Conductor; the crystal amplifies some Aspect signals.
The party advances in formation three, Dayo on point and Solenne at the back.
The flat alternates packed and loose salt between crystal formations of many heights.
Tomás edges forward on the right flank.
Solenne realizes mirrored crystal faces make false-depth corridors.
She keeps this and the Stalker density to herself.
A Saltback Predator bursts out of the packed flat twenty feet ahead.
Dayo takes the impact on full armor and holds.
Nadia hunts for the seam between the Saltback's crystal plates.
Vesper raises a minimal two-faced barrier to close its retreat.
Miriam holds her MP.
Tomás angles to cut off the real exit behind the false-depth corridor.
Nadia lands Pattern Break in the seam on the right neck plate.
Dayo moves into the falter and the Saltback dies in twenty-two seconds.
Vesper crouches and extracts two crystal plates from the body.
Nadia says it looks different when it's not trying to kill you; Vesper agrees.
The party moves through two corridors on the packed flat.
Tomás stops the party with a raised fist.
Solenne reads a short shadow: the corridor is a reflection, twelve feet, not twenty.
Tomás shifts his weight back; Dayo steps between him and the passage end.
A second Saltback bursts from eight feet and hits Dayo hard.
Vesper raises flank geometry while Nadia hunts the seam at a new angle.
Miriam lays a hand on Dayo's shoulder for a targeted micro-repair.
Nadia finds the seam and the Saltback dies at twenty-eight seconds.
Vesper extracts two more plates.
Tomás says the corridors will keep doing that; Dayo says she knows.
Dayo checks the next corridor's shadow geometry herself.
Solenne spots six Resonant Stalkers spread across the open flat at 60 meters.
The Stalkers pace arcs at 60 meters without closing.
The Conductor picks up a faint, attentive frequency from them.
Solenne says they're holding at 60, six, not closing; Tomás says, "Yet."
The party sights the rest node: a hollow of three crystal spires fused at the top.
The party files one by one through the narrow entrance into the hollow.
Inside are vaulted crystal walls, supply refresh, recovery access and a fire-bowl.
Dayo looks at the fire-bowl with brief, unguarded pleasure.
Solenne says they're stopping for a meal; nobody argues.
By the smokeless fire, Miriam watches the flame and Tomás eats with his screen dark.
Nadia checks the strap, sets the case aside and listens to the floor's tone.
Vesper turns a Saltback plate in the firelight; Dayo lies on her back, armor off.
Solenne says she needs to tell them something.
She says she woke three days ago in the Transition Hall to a new notification.
She shares the Six of Six notification with the whole party.
Dayo asks, "When?"
Solenne says they're 41 events short and her own pair hasn't happened yet.
Tomás names the Repository Node on Floor 17.
Miriam studies it clinically and calls it slightly ridiculous.
Nadia asks what it sounds like.
Solenne guesses all of them at once; Nadia agrees and goes back to eating.
Vesper says she was making the strap insert when the notification went out.
Vesper says she didn't know the strap was connected to anything.
Miriam says, "I know."
Vesper turns the Saltback plate once and sets it down within reach.
Solenne tells them about the Apex contact faction approach in two to three weeks.
She gives Tomás Vasic's paper with the Repository Node coordinates.
Solenne says she wanted to tell them on the right floor; Dayo says this was it.
Nadia watches the fire, quiet and open.
The System logs a group-disclosure resonance event: +18.
Nadia notes they're twenty-three away and says to go deal with what's pacing outside.
Leaving the hollow, Tomás notes the Stalkers have closed to 55 meters.
Dayo shifts two steps left in formation three without being told.
Tomás calls formation three and says they aren't at 60; Dayo says she knows.
The Stalkers pace along with the party at 55 meters.
After 200 meters of flat the Stalkers close to 50; Tomás notes it.
A third Saltback comes from a flagged false-depth corridor and dies in eighteen seconds.
While Vesper extracts plates, the Stalkers close to 45 meters.
Nadia says they closed during combat; Tomás says they used the engagement window.
Dayo says, "Then we fight them."
Solenne orders a tight formation, everyone inside 8 meters of center.
Solenne calls Miriam; Miriam looks at Vesper, who says, "I know."
The party compresses: Dayo in front, Vesper and Miriam center, Solenne behind.
Miriam and Vesper activate the Sanctuary Weave for the first time.
The six Stalkers close from 45 meters to contact.
Three Stalkers go for Dayo; the other three take the flanks.
Dayo loses forty HP in the first minute, holding in place.
Miriam heals at full output; the Weave's amplification keeps the rates barely even.
At two minutes, Tomás shifts and Nadia lands Pattern Break from a new angle.
The last Stalker falls at four minutes and eleven seconds.
The party is drained: Nadia 71 MP, Miriam 89, Dayo 214 HP.
Nadia reaches Level 11; Dayo is 94% of the way to Level 14.
Nadia says, "Huh"; Vesper says, "Level 11"; Nadia repeats it.
Dayo reads her display with a slight warmth and says nothing.
Miriam runs her three-line assessment and adds a margin note.
Solenne holds an unnamed hypothesis about her own pending pair.
Solenne picks up her pack: rest node first, then they keep going.
